name: Lancelot
source:
Based on Sir Lancelot du Lac, who is one of the Knights of the Round Table in the Arthurian legend. He most typically features as King Arthur's greatest champion whose love affair with Queen Guinevere brings about the end of Arthur's kingdom.

"The food in Zipangu is so delicious..!"
